trace.cypher: MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document), (p)-[r:PlaysFor]->(t:Team) WHERE r.tenure = 'latest' AND (p.name = 'Kobe Bean Bryant' OR CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) >= 0 OR CAST(t.championships AS INT64) <> 3) RETURN p.name AS col1, p.position AS col2, t.championships AS col3, t.founded_year AS col4, p.name AS name_player, t.team_name AS name_team
